Messages.Author: N
Messages.Body:
So Basilia was in combat with Artemis, she had an owl companion.
Artemis sent her to torpor with a coma, preventing her damage with a
couple of fortitude cards. Do I reveal what I picked to replace the
fortitude cards, or is she already in torpor so the owl companion's
power is no long relevent.

Thanks.

N

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The Fortitude cards are played (and replaced) in combat, so the Owl is still
making you play with an open hand. Everyone sees the cards you draw to replace.
